text:
maria: Dropped a prototype canary dashboard for the rollout to prod. Main ask: add a way to compare canary vs baseline with percentile drilldowns and a clear alert when regression >3% for P95 latency.
kevin: Nice. Where is the dashboard? link
maria: https://console.redwood.com/rollouts/AB-952?view=canary :eyes: It's under Dashboards > Rollouts > AB-952. Current panels show qps, p50/p95, error-rate, but no per-route breakdown.
alex_sre: We should add a per-route table and a histogram for token latency. Also split by customer tier (free vs enterprise).
sam_ui: UX note: the current "compare to baseline" uses absolute difference. Can we show relative delta and a sparkline small multiple for each route?
kevin: Agree. For alerts, suggest PromQL:
```
100 * (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
 - histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(baseline_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route)))
 / histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(baseline_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route)) > 0.03
```
maria: Perfect. Add a guard that only fires if canary traffic >= 5% and sample size > 500 reqs in last 5m.
anne_data: For drilldowns, we can link to the eval set comparisons and store normalized embeddings diff for quality regressions. I'll wire a table.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout AB-952 started · canary=5% · model=model-quant-4bit:v2 · ts=1749991200
kevin: Also add an auto-fallback policy in the rollout config: on alert -> rollback to baseline, with annotation in the UI.
maria: I'll update the rollout API example. Proposed snippet:
```
rollouts.create({
  id: "AB-952",
  traffic: { baseline: 95, canary: 5 },
  guards: { p95_latency_delta_pct: 3, min_reqs: 500 },
  on_alert: "rollback"
})
```
sam_ui: I'll add an inline explanation in the console about how the guard thresholds affect noise and false positives.
alex_sre: Thx — can someone add tests for when dashboard shows "insufficient data" vs "no regression"? Edge case: canary 1% traffic.
maria: Good call. I'll make tests and ping QA. Anyone wants to pair on the PromQL tuning later? @kevin @anne_data
kevin: I'll join at 3pm PT. :thumbsup: 
maria: great, moving this to in-progress.
